reportMarkdown:
## Split Taffy Node Request Telemetry Finished

**Index:** 74
**Checkpoint:** `bf4f059`
**Result:** `e5bdc30de`
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status:** true. A separate diagnostics-only 11-counter array preserves the existing 31-counter layout telemetry and compiles out of production builds. Both headed DPRs produced identical request partitions: all 1,123 nodes were pooled, all 1,123 converted styles and ordered topologies compared equal, and no new node, style write, or topology write occurred. All 229 measured contexts refilled retained slots without another dirty mark. Every one of the 1,041 child edges inserted a unique active child.

The result rules out new-node allocation, redundant context dirtying, and duplicate child filtering for the warmed workload. The remaining request cost is the verification itself: upstream `Style::to_taffy` conversion plus exact retained-style and ordered-topology comparisons. The previous topology-shadow failure means a later optimization must establish a cheaper sound invalidation signal, not maintain a parallel child copy.

Headed Chromium/WebGPU passed both DPR cases with exact final offset and zero terminal errors. All 419 gpux tests and integration suites, all 52 serialized WGPU tests, package checks, warning-denied Clippy, Test Suite production/diagnostic checks, focused formatting, diff checks, and AgentX memory audit passed. Existing unrelated Test Suite warnings remain.

### Scope Lock

Only diagnostics-gated node-request counters, their existing Scene/WGPU/Web transport, Test Suite proof, and durable guidance changed. Production layout, caching, topology, dependencies, and allocation behavior are unchanged.

### Repository Checkpoints

| Repo | Path | Checkpoint | Result Commit | Status | Rollback |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main | . | `bf4f059` | `e5bdc30de` | committed | `git -C "D:\\Work\\projects\\RayX\\RayX" reset --hard bf4f0591f2afafc4b3d80fa997e48d9f48fe3b97` |

### Decision

Accept the bounded telemetry. Do not optimize new-node creation, repeated dirty marking, or duplicate child insertion for the warmed DataTable. Investigate whether a sound caller-visible style/layout generation can avoid repeated conversion and equality verification without relying on pool position.
decisionMarkdown: Accept the split diagnostics-only request telemetry. It proves a fully warm 1,123-node request stream with exact style/topology equality, zero writes, no redundant dirty marks, and no duplicate active-child insertions. Use a later experiment to measure or introduce a sound style/layout generation; do not repeat the failed topology shadow.
